definition_en: The ability to understand one's own strengths and weaknesses, manage one's emotions and behaviour, and maintain drive and commitment toward goals.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami kekuatan dan kelemahan diri, mengurus emosi dan tingkah laku, serta mengekalkan dorongan dan komitmen terhadap matlamat.
typical_tasks_en:
• Reflect on last quarter's feedback and set three personal improvement goals.
• Recognise that delegation is a weakness and ask the supervisor for coaching.
• Stay focused on a repetitive data-cleaning task for three hours to meet the audit deadline.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Renungkan maklum balas suku lalu dan tetapkan tiga matlamat peningkatan diri.
• Sedari bahawa delegasi adalah kelemahan dan minta penyelia memberi bimbingan.
• Kekal fokus pada tugasan pembersihan data berulang selama tiga jam untuk memenuhi tarikh akhir audit.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires self-reflection or evaluating one's own performance
• The task involves managing personal emotions in a work context
• The task requires setting and pursuing personal development goals
• The task involves recognising one's own limitations and seeking improvement
• The task requires sustaining effort and commitment over time
exclusion_rules:
• The task is externally mandated with no personal initiative required
• The user performs tasks without any need for self-assessment
• The task involves no emotional or interpersonal dimension
• The user is simply following orders without internal engagement
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task is externally mandated with no sign of self-reflection, emotion management, or personal drive.

confusions.boundary_rule: Motivation is about internal drive and self-knowledge. Curiosity is about the desire to learn new things.
confusions.example_task: I feel bored in my role, so I will explore new skills to stay engaged.
confusions.expected_labels: Motivation and self-awareness; Curiosity and lifelong learning

confusions.boundary_rule: Motivation is internal drive. Resilience is recovering from external setbacks.
confusions.example_task: After failing to meet a target, motivate myself to try a different approach.
confusions.expected_labels: Motivation and self-awareness; Resilience, flexibility and agility

confusions.boundary_rule: Self-awareness is understanding oneself. Empathy is understanding others.
confusions.example_task: Recognise that my frustration is affecting how I listen to my colleague.
confusions.expected_labels: Motivation and self-awareness; Empathy and active listening

examples.evidence: because the manager told me to
